title: Spanish present tense of regular verbs
snippet: The present tense of regular Spanish verbs.
content: Regular verbs in the present tense drop -ar, -er or -ir and add the person ending. Example: Yo hablo español y tú comes paella. Practice: Complete: Nosotros ___ en Sevilla. (vivir) Answer: vivimos.

title: Spanish preterite for completed events
snippet: Use the preterite for completed events.
content:
The preterite narrates completed events with a clear end point, such as ayer or anoche. Example: Ayer hablé con mi hermana. Practice: Complete: Anoche nosotros ___ en un restaurante. (cenar) Answer: cenamos.

Irregular preterite forms like fui, hice and tuve are frequent for completed events. Example: El verano pasado fui a México.

title: Preterite and imperfect contrast in a story
snippet: Contrast the imperfect and the preterite.
content: In a story the imperfect sets the scene and the preterite contrast tells the completed event that interrupts it. Example: Llovía cuando llegué a casa. Practice: Complete: Mientras yo leía, ___ el teléfono. (sonar) Answer: sonó.

title: Present subjunctive after doubt
content: After expressions of doubt such as dudo que or no creo que, the verb takes the present subjunctive. Example: No creo que sea verdad. Practice: Complete: No pienso que ella ___ razón. (tener) Answer: tenga.

title: Argumentative writing in Spanish
content: Argumentative writing states a claim, gives reasons with connectors and ends with a conclusion. Example: Por un lado es caro; sin embargo, es útil. Practice: Complete the connector: Por un lado es caro; por ___ lado es útil. Answer: otro.

title: Solving linear equations
content: A linear equation is solved by applying inverse operations to both sides until x is alone. Example: 2x + 3 = 11, so 2x = 8 and x = 4. Practice: Solve for x: 3x - 2 = 10 Answer: 4.

title: Systems of linear equations
content: A system of linear equations is solved by substitution or elimination of one variable. Example: x + y = 5 and x - y = 1 give x = 3. Practice: Solve the system x + y = 7 and x - y = 3. What is y? Answer: 2.

title: Quadratic equations by factoring
content: A quadratic equation is solved by factoring it into two linear factors and setting each to zero. Example: x^2 - 5x + 6 = (x - 2)(x - 3), so x = 2 or x = 3. Practice: Solve the quadratic x^2 = 49 and give the positive root. Answer: 7.
